title: Sodium hydroxide solutions
text:
Sodium hydroxide solutions

Sample recipe written for trying the app. Import your school’s CLEAPSS Recipe Sheets (Admin → Import & export → Recipes) for the real ones.

1. Wear goggles and gloves.
2. Weigh the pellets quickly (they absorb water from the air).
3. Add them a few at a time to about two-thirds of the final volume of cold water, stirring — the solution gets hot.
4. Cool, make up to the final volume and mix.
5. Store in a labelled plastic bottle with a screw cap.

title: Hydrochloric acid solutions
text:
Hydrochloric acid solutions

Sample recipe written for trying the app. Import your school’s CLEAPSS Recipe Sheets (Admin → Import & export → Recipes) for the real ones.

1. Wear goggles; use a fume cupboard for the concentrated acid.
2. Measure the concentrated acid in a measuring cylinder.
3. Add it to about two-thirds of the final volume of water (acid to water).
4. Make up to the final volume and mix.
5. Label with the concentration and hazard.

title: Sulfuric acid solutions
text:
Sulfuric acid solutions

Sample recipe written for trying the app. Import your school’s CLEAPSS Recipe Sheets (Admin → Import & export → Recipes) for the real ones.

1. Wear goggles, face shield and gloves.
2. Add the concentrated acid slowly, with stirring, to about two-thirds of the final volume of cold water — never water to acid.
3. Let it cool, make up to the final volume and mix.

title: Copper(II) sulfate solutions
text:
Copper(II) sulfate solutions

Sample recipe written for trying the app. Import your school’s CLEAPSS Recipe Sheets (Admin → Import & export → Recipes) for the real ones.

1. Wear eye protection.
2. Weigh the blue crystals and dissolve in about two-thirds of the final volume of water.
3. Make up to the final volume and mix.

title: Sodium chloride solutions
text:
Sodium chloride solutions

Sample recipe written for trying the app. Import your school’s CLEAPSS Recipe Sheets (Admin → Import & export → Recipes) for the real ones.

1. Weigh the salt, dissolve in water and make up to the final volume.

title: Sodium thiosulfate solutions
text:
Sodium thiosulfate solutions

Sample recipe written for trying the app. Import your school’s CLEAPSS Recipe Sheets (Admin → Import & export → Recipes) for the real ones.

1. Weigh the crystals and dissolve in water; make up to the final volume.
2. Solutions go cloudy over time — make them up shortly before use.
